fullDescription: A gamified and nurturing diagnostic quiz design characterized by an editorial-meets-modern aesthetic. Featuring a warm earth-toned palette of terracotta and teal against a cream background, it uses a sophisticated mix of Zodiak serif typography and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text. The interface is highly interactive with fluid slide-in transitions, staggered animations, and organic floating background blobs. Suitable for pet care, wellness, holistic health, and educational coaching verticals looking to build high-conversion lead generation funnels with a premium, trustworthy feel.

structured.summary: An editorial-style diagnostic quiz featuring a multi-step progress flow, icon-based option cards, and a comprehensive result page with data visualization scores and product recommendations.

style.description: The style is 'Editorial Nurture,' balancing high-end serif typography (Zodiak) with clean sans-serif body text (Plus Jakarta Sans). Colors include Terracotta (#D85A30) for accents, Teal (#0F6E56) for primary structure, Cream (#F4EDE4) for backgrounds, and Graphite (#2C2C2A) for text. Visuals include 24px-32px border radii, soft border-stroke (black/5), and smooth cubic-bezier transitions for a fluid, organic user experience.
style.prompt: Create a UI with a primary color of Teal (#0F6E56) and accent color of Terracotta (#D85A30) on a Cream (#F4EDE4) background. Typography: Use 'Zodiak' (serif) for headings with -0.02em letter spacing, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text. Corners should be rounded with 'rounded-3xl' (24px) or higher. Backgrounds should feature large, blurred color blobs (#D85A30 at top-left, #0F6E56 at bottom-right) with 80px blur at 20% opacity. Animations: Use 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' for all transitions. Interactive elements must have a hover state that lifts -4px and adds a 2px Terracotta border. Shadows should be subtle (black/5) or intense for result cards (shadow-2xl).

layout_and_structure.description: A centered container-based layout with a clear hierarchy: progress header, central question area, and a modular results dashboard.

prompts.prompt: A top-aligned header containing a small branding element (icon + uppercase tracking-widest text) on the left and a 'Step X of Y' counter on the right. Below, a full-width progress bar (8px height) using a light Teal background (#0F6E56/10) with a Teal fill that expands using a 'cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)' easing.

A centered text stack featuring a 4xl-5xl serif heading (#0F6E56) followed by an lg-sized description in Graphite at 60% opacity. Below, a 2-column grid (on desktop) of selection cards. Each card must have a 48px square icon container with 10% opacity background of the icon's color.

A dedicated loading screen with a pulsing paw-print or brand-relevant icon in the center. Use 'animate-ping' for a background pulse and a static primary-colored icon on top. Add italicized Graphite/60% text below explaining the 'analysis' process.

A large 40px-rounded card. The top section is a 'Hero' area with a Teal background and a subtle dot-grid pattern (white/10). It should feature a large 'Result Profile' title and a sub-description. Below the hero, a 3-column stats grid with Cream-colored background cards displaying large bold percentages or scores. The final section includes a 'Detailed Analysis' text block and a featured product CTA card.

special_ui_components.description: A button-based card with icon, title, and subtitle.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a button with 'rounded-3xl', p-6 padding, and a 1px border (#000000/5). Include a 12x12 (48px) icon container with a color-coded background (#D85A30 or #0F6E56 at 10% opacity). Title should be bold and Teal, subtitle should be small and Graphite/60%. On hover, transform: translateY(-4px) and border-color: #D85A30.

special_ui_components.description: A high-contrast CTA section at the bottom of the results.
special_ui_components.prompt: A container with Terracotta (#D85A30) at 5% opacity and a 10% opacity border. Features a 1/3 (image) to 2/3 (text) split on desktop. Text includes a bold primary title, a small 'Indication' label in uppercase, and a price display. The CTA button must be solid Terracotta (#D85A30) with white bold text and a right-arrow icon.

structured.special_notes: MUST use staggered entrance animations (0.1s increments) for list items. MUST use a serif/sans-serif font pairing to maintain the editorial feel. DO NOT use sharp corners; minimum border-radius is 16px. DO NOT use pure white as a primary background; always use the Cream (#F4EDE4) for a warmer, professional feel.
